title: Build your panel profile
subtitle: The more you tell us, the more (paid) studies we can match you to. Tap whatever applies — answer as much or as little as you like.
loadError: We couldn't load your profile. Please try again.
saveError: We couldn't save that. Please try again.
stopAnytime: You can stop anytime — every answer helps us match you to better studies.
sensitiveBody: Some of the best-paid studies need a bit more — like health, income, or lifestyle. These are sensitive, so we only collect them with your explicit consent, and you can change your mind anytime.
portalBody: Enter your email and we'll send you a secure link to add to your profile.
requestSentBody: If you're on our panel, we've sent you a secure link to manage your profile.
joinSubtitle: Take part in paid research studies — short voice interviews you can do from any device, whenever it suits you.
joinStep1: Sign up with your email — it takes 30 seconds.
joinStep2: Tell us a bit about yourself so we can match you to relevant studies.
joinStep3: Get invited to studies that fit your profile. Each invitation states the topic, duration, and reward.
